stage: Research P0 -> P1 -> limited P2 -> P3 stop
occlusion: none; full known proxy obstacle disk and centroid observation, not LiDAR
current_occupancy: 10Hz instantaneous observed disk + .5m inflation factor6; no STVL decay/frustum, no future union
time_score: frozen R2 squared hinge .4m influence, .02m margin, 10000 collision weight, 1 weight
worthwhile_efficiency: B vs Aprime and CV: >=10% paired median time improvement and >=2/3 pairs same direction in >=2 dynamic scenes, no new collision or loss of safe task completion anywhere
worthwhile_safety: B meets body clearance >=.05m and success in all 3 seeds of a scene where Aprime or CV has >=2/3 failures; no new safety/task regression elsewhere
threshold_basis: 10% exceeds one 100ms tick and small fixture jitter; .05m inherited research clearance gate; n=3 exploratory signal, no significance claim
fallback: on exception/stale source >.4s/compute over100ms, enqueue zero target through same delayed acceleration-limited plant; retain command during output delay; no safety certification
oracle_boundary: only future obstacle positions at source_age + (k+1)*dt; same observations/robot state/current map/geometry/budget/plant as C; no robot future truth
D: optional offline finite waiting witnesses; unlimited offline scheduling, same constrained plant, excluded from controller comparison
resource: new reproducible cache <=150MiB, evidence <=30MiB, stop large writes if available <3GiB
